race.comment: REAL HEIR (2) came from midfield to run well in what should be a stronger maiden first up. This does appear his right distance. Just has to overcome the barrier which can be tricky around here. One of the players. CHARLEANOR (4) does draw a little better than other favoured chances. She has made nice improvement through the prep. Won't get a better chance to break the maiden. LA VELOCITA (7) just keeps finding a few better. This race should be easier than the Cranbourne ones. Finds a soft gate too. FANFIRE (5) was a lot better first to second run last campaign. From a good yard.
